status: design proposal, not meshed or run
target_wall_yplus: approximately 1 or below over the resolved foil surface
rationale: Measured M03 first-layer scaling gives approximately 3.23 to 5.86 micrometres for y+=1 over the central 90% of fully layered surface area. 3 micrometres provides a modest starting margin. Actual y+ must be remeasured.
controls: Keep M03 tangential and outer mesh settings for the first wall-normal comparison.
Inspect and repair local layer collapse at the sharp trailing edge without changing foil geometry.
Retain SST and All y+ for the first comparison; the low-y+ branch is recovered on a sufficiently fine mesh.
Recheck mesh quality, achieved layer thickness and coverage, CFL and inner convergence before extending the solver.
Separate a later leading-edge refinement experiment from the wall-normal refinement test.
cost: Cell count and runtime are unknown until meshed and benchmarked; do not multiply whole mesh cell count by the 60x first-layer reduction.
